metrics.title: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery via MCP Remote Tool Endpoint
metrics.rationale: Arbitrary outbound HTTP requests can be initiated from the SSE tool transport to internal cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) or VPC backends.

metrics.title: CWE-77: Indirect Prompt Injection leading to Arbitrary Tool Dispatch
metrics.rationale: Untrusted web content ingested by the agent can hijack the reasoning chain and execute unreviewed bash commands in the demo environment.

metrics.title: CWE-250: Container Sandbox Escape via Insecure Host IPC Sharing
metrics.rationale: The ephemeral worker container shares host IPC semaphores, allowing memory injection into the host runtime daemon.

metrics.title: CWE-444: Multi-Tenant Prompt Cache Desynchronization & Data Leakage
metrics.snippet:
cache_key = hashlib.sha256(prompt_str.encode()).hexdigest()
# Missing tenant_id segregation in cache key derivation
metrics.rationale: Identical system prompt prefixes across distinct corporate tenants collide in RedisPromptCache, returning cached responses across tenant boundaries.

metrics.title: CWE-798: Fallback Hardcoded Session Token in Mock Test Harness
metrics.rationale: Hardcoded test credentials exposed in open-source repository could allow unauthorized access if matching mock relays are running.

metrics.title: CWE-502: Unsafe YAML Deserialization in Dynamic Skill Loader
metrics.snippet:
with open(yaml_path) as f:
    return yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.Loader) # Unsafe Loader allows Python code instantiation
metrics.rationale: Loading untrusted third-party skill definitions invokes arbitrary object constructors via Python yaml.Loader.

metrics.motivation: Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration & Cloud Enclave Compromise
